summary: Backend-only verification of the AI Lesson Plan Generator blank-field bug fix (POST /api/lesson-plans/generate-from-schedule). Inserted a TEST_ fillable docx template with 11 section_labels ['Learner Outcomes','Standards','Anticipatory Set','Modeling','Instructional Strategies','Check for Understanding','Guided Practice','Independent Practice','Closure','Differentiation','Assessment'] for the admin teacher, then ran generation against real turtle lessons. 9/9 pytest tests passed. Across 4 independent generations (single-day + multi-day day-1/day-2 spans, 3 different turtle chapters) the AI returned ALL 11 keys with non-empty strings every time and no extra/renamed keys — 'Learner Outcomes' and 'Standards' were populated in 4/4 runs (Standards cited real CSTA codes 1B-AP-10 / 2-AP-13). Verified persistence via GET /api/lesson-plans (sections intact, no _id leak), end-to-end docx fill via GET /api/lesson-plans/{id}/download/0 (parsed the returned .docx with python-docx and confirmed the generated Learner Outcomes/Standards/Closure text is actually written into the document), backward-compat without template_id (freeform `content` returned, no crash), the no-grounding-data guard, and role gating (unauthenticated 401, bad token 401, student session 403 on both generate and list). Fixtures cleaned up.

minor.issue: No server-side backstop: the guarantee that every template label is populated rests entirely on LLM prompt compliance (non-deterministic). If gpt-4o omits a label on some future call, sections silently lacks that key and the docx section is left blank again — reproducing the original user-reported bug. Recommend a deterministic post-parse fill: for every label in template_labels missing/blank in `sections`, set a fallback (e.g. 'See attached activities').

If the LLM ever responds with non-JSON, the except branch sets sections = {} (server.py ~L10755), so the docx fill gets nothing at all and every section is blank. No logging is emitted on that parse failure either — add logger.warning plus a 'Label:'-heading regex fallback parse of filled_text.

system_prompt (server.py ~L10611) still instructs 'Only include keys for sections the teacher's template actually has.' — mild tension with the new labels_directive that demands all keys. Not observed to cause failures, but worth aligning the two prompts.

action_items: Optional hardening (no functional bug found): add a deterministic post-parse backfill so any template_label missing or blank in `sections` gets a placeholder string instead of silently disappearing.
Add logger.warning + a heading-regex fallback parse in the JSON-parse except branch so a non-JSON LLM response does not produce an entirely empty sections dict.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 18,258 lines — far past the maintainability threshold; the lesson-plan endpoints (~L10076-10880) are a clean candidate for extraction into a router module.
The blank-field fix is prompt-only. Prompt engineering is not a contract; pair it with a server-side completeness check over template_labels before persisting.

sections values are cast with str(v) — if the model returns a list or dict for a section, the docx gets a stringified Python literal (e.g. "['a', 'b']"). Consider joining lists into newline-separated text.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 pytest tests, 4/4 generation runs fully populated)

seed_data_creation: Inserted lesson_plan_templates doc 'TEST_Fillable_Template.docx' (real python-docx bytes, fillable=True, 11 section_labels) for admin teacher astapp@spanola.net; generated 9 TEST_ lesson_plans; temporary TEST_student_* session for the 403 gate. ALL cleaned up via /app/backend/tests/cleanup_lesson_plan_fixture.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BUG FIX IS VERIFIED WORKING — Learner Outcomes and Standards are now always populated. To re-run: `cd /app/backend && python tests/setup_lesson_plan_fixture.py` (creates the TEST_ template and writes tests/.lesson_plan_fixture.json, and auto-discovers turtle chapter/lesson combos that actually have problems), then `python -m pytest tests/test_lesson_plan_ai_sections.py -v -p no:randomly`, then `python tests/cleanup_lesson_plan_fixture.py`. The setup step is mandatory because cleanup deletes the template. Turtle lessons with problems: 'Chapter 3: Colors'/'Lesson 3: Rainbow Colors', 'Chapter 5: Functions'/'Lesson 2: Parameters', 'Chapter 6: Projects'/'Lesson 1: Geometric Art'. Student auth is Emergent OAuth-only, so the student 403 test injects a session row into Mongo directly. Generation is fast (~6-8s per day) despite the LLM call.
rca_of_the_issue: Original root cause (already fixed by previous agent): the prompt told the model 'Only include a key if you have real content for it... Skip labels that are purely structural', so gpt-4o silently dropped keys like 'Learner Outcomes' and 'Standards' it considered structural, and the docx-fill then left those sections blank. The new labels_directive (server.py L10670-10703) enumerates the exact required JSON keys with per-section guidance and an explicit 'NEVER return an empty string' rule; the defensive change at L10751 also keeps empty-string values so the docx placeholder is still replaced. Verified: 4/4 generations returned all 11 labels non-empty, and the filled docx contains that text. Residual risk is non-determinism — see minor issues for the recommended server-side backstop.
